## Description

**What**: Add the scratch path to the tickets-worktree's local `.git/info/exclude` (per the epic Approach — not a committed `.gitignore`); audit the Jira reconciler so it reads zero bytes from the scratch directory; add a verification harness asserting the isolation invariant; make `ticket-init.sh` idempotent so the exclusion entry is added to existing pre-upgrade worktrees on re-run.

**Why**: Scratch is ephemeral, large, and potentially sensitive — it must never enter the tickets-branch git object database or the Jira sync surface. The epic explicitly specifies `.git/info/exclude` (a per-clone exclude), not a committed `.gitignore`, to keep the exclusion out of tickets-branch history itself.

**Scope**:
- IN: `.git/info/exclude` entry on tickets-tracker worktree; reconciler path-exclusion audit (or filter, if any code path currently traverses); verification test that walks the scratch path and confirms both `git ls-files` and the reconciler input list are empty for that path; idempotent `ticket-init.sh` re-run that adds the exclusion entry without duplication and without disturbing other entries.
- OUT: CLI (separate story), migration (separate story), cleanup (separate story).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the scratch path is added to the tickets-tracker worktree's `.git/info/exclude` (per epic Approach — not a committed `.gitignore`), and `git check-ignore` confirms the exclusion applies
  ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, the Jira reconciler code path does not open, read, or enumerate any file under the scratch directory; verified by a targeted test that creates a scratch file and asserts the reconciler input set excludes it
  ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, a verification harness asserts `git ls-files` on the scratch path returns empty on the tickets branch even when scratch contents exist on disk
  ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, `ticket-init.sh` is idempotent: re-running it against existing tickets-tracker worktrees that predate this epic adds the exclusion entry without duplication and without disturbing other entries; covered by a behavioral test against a pre-upgrade worktree fixture
  ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic
  ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations

- [Security] Scratch may carry sub-agent payloads with credentials or PII; the isolation invariant is a security boundary, not just a sync optimization.
- [Test] The verification harness should run in CI so future reconciler refactors cannot silently regress the boundary.
- [Upgrade-path] Per-clone `.git/info/exclude` is not propagated by git pull — existing worktrees must be patched on `ticket-init.sh` re-run.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a Jira-sync operator, I want the scratch path excluded from tickets-branch history and reconciler reads, so that handoff payloads never leak into Jira or the tickets git history
